2607.02944.title: A Precedent-Guided Co-Scientist for Side-Effect-Aware Drug Redesign
2607.02944.paper_summary: We propose PRECEDE, a precedent-guided co-scientist for side-effect-aware drug redesign that revises a parent compound to mitigate a specified side effect while preserving therapeutic function. Rather than isolated molecular generation, PRECEDE frames redesign as evidence-grounded reasoning over drug--side-effect associations, biomedical knowledge graphs, and precedents of safety-driven optimization, coordinated by an LLM orchestrator with explicit policies and human-review checkpoints. We position PRECEDE as a human-supervised AI-for-science workflow in which hypotheses remain auditable, falsifiable, and bounded by prior pharmacology.
2607.02944.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了PRECEDE，一個以先例為導向的共同科學家，用於意識到副作用的藥物重新設計，旨在修訂父化合物以減輕特定副作用，同時保留治療功能。PRECEDE並不是孤立的分子生成，而是將重新設計框架設為基於證據的推理，涉及藥物與副作用的關聯、生物醫學知識圖譜以及安全驅動優化的先例，這一切由具有明確政策和人類審查檢查點的LLM協調器進行協調。我們將PRECEDE定位為一個人類監督的AI科學工作流程，其中假設保持可審核、可證偽，並受到先前藥理學的限制。
2607.02944.author: Yujin Kim et.al.
